scope: Reference planner for generally healthy nonpregnant adults. It constrains generated quantities, not unmeasured total intake or individual contraindications. Do not describe the output as personally safe or interaction-free.
assumptions: No kidney disease or other diagnosed condition
Caffeine is optional, early-day and at least 8 hours before bedtime

rules.description: Priorities determine inclusion, never multiply doses. One dose per compound even with overlapping goals.
Exclude caffeine when Sleep or Calm matches/exceeds Focus/Energy, or either reaches 4. Preference cutoff is not a clinical safety threshold.
No automatic magnesium, vitamin D, omega-3, melatonin, or theanine. Missing indication or long-term evidence is not filled in by priorities.

constraints.limitKind: No established tolerable upper intake limit; 3 g/day is a conservative planner choice, not an official safety limit.
exclusions: Kidney disease or unknown renal suitability

constraints.limitKind: EFSA safety assessment levels, not a nutrient UL or recommended target.

assessmentLevels.scope: Single dose from all sources in healthy adults
Habitual intake from all sources in healthy nonpregnant adults

interactions: Other caffeine and stimulant products add to exposure
exclusions: Known rhythm disorder or diagnosed anxiety
Other intake or timing not compatible with the assumed reference conditions

constraints.limitKind: No established UL. Short-term trial tolerability does not define a universal safe daily ceiling.
interactions: Medication and blood-pressure context not assessed

constraints.limitKind: US adult UL applies to supplements and medications only; naturally occurring food magnesium excluded.

additionalLimits.scope: EU: readily dissociable magnesium salts and compounds in supplemental/added sources; naturally present food magnesium excluded.

adverseEffects: Toxicity risk increases with kidney impairment
interactions: Oral bisphosphonates: separate by at least 2 hours
Tetracycline/quinolone antibiotics: take at least 2 hours before or 4–6 hours after magnesium
Diuretics and proton-pump inhibitors can affect magnesium status

constraints.limitKind: Adult UL from all oral sources; equivalent to 100 micrograms/day.
interactions: Thiazide diuretics can increase hypercalcemia risk

constraints.limitKind: No established nutrient UL for EPA/DHA; reported safety assessment levels are not recommendation targets.
adverseEffects: High-dose trials report increased atrial-fibrillation risk
interactions: Anticoagulants warrant clinical review and monitoring

constraints.limitKind: No established UL; long-term safety data insufficient.
interactions: Blood thinners and epilepsy require medical supervision
exclusions: Routine daily use without circadian indication
